exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI categorized using Asia-specific cut-offs
cohort: 2702 women with live singleton deliveries at three tertiary centers in Korea between 2010 and 2011
finding: Optimal gestational weight gain (GWG) ranges for Korean women, based on Asia-specific BMI categories, were wider and higher than those recommended by the Institute of Medicine (IOM).
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was one of the composite perinatal outcomes used to determine optimal GWG.
